summary.run_type: On-demand Singapore/Hong Kong + Tier 1 global employer sweep
summary.run_status: Complete for requested slice — Singapore and Hong Kong city discovery plus Tier 1 ranks 1–122; broader 14-city discovery and ranks 123–438 deferred.
summary.sources_checked: Employer career pages and ATS inventories; LinkedIn; public job boards and aggregators used as labeled leads; official sources prioritized for validation.
summary.notes: This was the requested focused slice, not the full 14-city / 438-company Fast Coverage run. All 122 Tier 1 employers received an explicit inventory outcome; four source-access gaps are marked unavailable rather than treated as no vacancy. 22 new role-city records were added, including lower-fit/senior/stretch listings so the user can triage them; four existing in-scope rows were refreshed (two DRW, one IMC, one Gent) and two false Hong Kong location rows were excluded. Official-source gaps and role-specific gates are detailed in the dated research report. No application/interview statuses were changed.
summary.locations_covered: Singapore; Hong Kong city-led discovery. Global vacancies screened across the 122 Tier 1 employer inventories.
summary.companies_covered: 122/122 Tier 1 ranked employers (ranks 1–36 Core priorities and 37–122 Power & Gas specialists) received an explicit outcome; ranks 123–438 not searched.
summary.source_families: Official employer careers/ATS; LinkedIn; public job boards and aggregators as leads; global ranked-employer inventory checks; Singapore/Hong Kong city-led vacancy discovery.
summary.coverage_gaps: No broad title-led searches in the other 12 registered cities; ranked employers beyond rank 122 not checked; four Tier 1 inventories could not be fully confirmed; masters/university sweep not in scope. A number of new leads are secondary-source postings and are labeled in the Jobs sheet.
summary.cadence_changes: None; next full weekly job sweep should restore all-city discovery and ranks 1–438.
summary.results_summary: 22 new role-city records; 1 existing role refreshed; 2 false HK location records excluded; 3 new company entities; 0 new office addresses. Most actionable immediate lead: SEFE Graduate LNG Singapore, deadline 2026-12-16. Strong analyst matches outside SG/HK include Shell Power Market Analyst London and Shell Power Fundamentals Forecasting London.
